summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. closed the acquisition of 100% interest in nine unpatented mining claims (the WO Claims) adjacent to its Springer tungsten project from GoldPlay LLC and Robert Schafer. Consideration included US$1 million cash, 188,199 common shares of Blue Moon, and a sliding-scale gross revenue royalty (3.0-5.0%) with a 3-year option to buy down to 1.5% for US$2 million. The transaction was arm's length with no finders' fees; no advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. The claims are located in the US, and the deal was previously announced on April 28, 2026. Watch for integration progress and any future royalty buy-down decision.
